text: Election of the Vice Chair of the Scarborough Community Council under Municipal Code Chapter 27, Council procedures, Appendix AII, for a term of office starting January 1, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022. All Members, including the incumbent, are eligible for election.

Scarborough Community Council: 1. Elected Councillor Cynthia Lai as Vice Chair of the Scarborough Community Council for a term of office starting January 1, 2021 and ending November 14, 2022 and until a successor is appointed.
